commands.name: search-packages
commands.summary: Autocomplete/search npm package names (npms.io suggestions used by the Bundlephobia search box)

commands.name: get-package-size
commands.summary: Get minified and gzipped bundle size, dependency count and module flags for an npm package (optionally a specific version)

commands.name: get-package-history
commands.summary: List a package's recent versions with their bundle sizes and publish dates, plus major/minor release markers

commands.name: get-similar-packages
commands.summary: Find alternative or similar packages in the same category as a given package

commands.name: list-recent-searches
commands.summary: List packages recently searched on Bundlephobia by all users, keyed by package name

commands.name: compare-trends
commands.summary: Compare download, star and size trends over time for several packages (the data behind the /trends page)

commands.name: get-github-package-json
commands.summary: Fetch the package.json of a GitHub repo (default branch) to list its dependencies for scanning with get-package-size

dropped.name: get-package-details
dropped.reason: The server-rendered __NEXT_DATA__ returns initialResult: null for a valid package, so the page does not reliably embed the result. get-package-size covers the same data from /api/size.
